preparing for war...

original_en:

speaker: Matron
original_en:

service, yet. What's the matter with Dipan?

speaker: Townsperson
original_en:

---

original_en:

speaker: Townsperson
original_en:

---
I really can't thank you enough!

original_en:

but I think the first monsters that appeared

original_en:

original_en:

but that will all change if Dipan falls.

original_en:

original_en:

speaker: Townsperson
original_en:

original_en:

speaker: Matron
original_en:
